short_summary: FTX faced a liquidity crisis after reports raised concerns about Alameda Research's balance sheet, leading to user withdrawals and eventual bankruptcy.

timeline.title: Alameda Research Balance Sheet Concerns
timeline.summary: Reports raised concerns about Alameda Research's balance sheet in relation to FTT

timeline.title: FTX Liquidity Crisis Begins
timeline.summary: Users began withdrawing funds from FTX after the Alameda report

timeline.title: Binance Withdraws Acquisition Deal
timeline.summary: Binance considers acquiring FTX but later withdraws from deal

open_questions: What was the exact nature of Alameda Research's balance sheet concerns?
How did Binance's withdrawal from the deal impact FTX's liquidity crisis?
final_assessment: The collapse of FTX cryptocurrency exchange can be attributed to a combination of factors, including reports on Alameda Research's balance sheet and user withdrawals, leading to a liquidity crisis.
